cohort: The study included patients with singleton pregnancies diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus after 20 weeks of gestation who had at least 7 days of previous daily blood glucose testing.
finding: Every-other-day blood glucose monitoring in GDM patients was found to be noninferior to daily monitoring regarding neonatal birth weight, medication initiation, and glucose control.
birth_weight: Not specified as an inclusion criterion; mean birth weights observed were 3090g (daily group) and 3181g (every-other-day group).
gest_age: GDM diagnosis after 20 weeks of gestation; medication started at various gestational ages.
